# Maccollab

> Maccollab is a coworking space and flexible office building in Brașov, Romania, at Strada Horia 22A, 500045 Brașov. It is the only coworking space in Brașov open 24/7, with key-card access every day of the week. It offers hot desks (day pass), dedicated desks, private offices, team offices and a conference room for up to 40 people. All prices are in euro and include VAT and utilities.

Maccollab is operated by Maccollab SRL. It is also a social enterprise that supports young people from the Brașov region, with a focus on people from vulnerable backgrounds.

Last updated: 2026-11-20

## Key facts

- Name: Maccollab
- Type: coworking space, office rental, meeting and conference room rental
- Address: Strada Horia 22A, 500045 Brașov, Romania
- Opening hours: open 24/7, every day, with a personal access card (the only 24/7 coworking space in Brașov)
- Phone: +40 731 624 845
- Email: office@maccollab.com
- Website: https://maccollab.com/ (Romanian) and https://maccollab.com/en/ (English)
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/5q1QS8x1Z2VHR9uRA
- Google rating: 5.0 from 22 Google reviews (November 2026)

## Prices (EUR, VAT and utilities included)

- Day pass / hot desk: 15€ per day or 50€ per week, no monthly membership
- Dedicated desk in the coworking area: 140€ per month
- Private office for 1–2 people: from 220€ per desk per month
- Small team office for 4–5 people: 180€ per desk per month
- Large team office for 9–14 people: 180€ per desk per month
- Conference room for up to 40 people (12 seats at the meeting table): 20€ per hour or 120€ per day, bookable by members and non-members
- Registered office address (sediu social) for companies: price on request
- Monthly offices have flexible monthly contracts with no long-term commitment

## What is included

- High-speed fibre-optic internet throughout the building
- Air conditioning, daily cleaning, tea, coffee and water
- Shared kitchen, lounge and bathrooms
- Outdoor garden on the premises
- Secure entry with a personal access card, 24/7
- Coworking desks (dedicated desk and day pass): height-adjustable desk, Steelcase ergonomic chair, Samsung Odyssey G55C monitor, GEEKOM mini PC with Hama wireless keyboard and mouse
- Conference room: display screen, projector, high-speed internet, air conditioning, tea, coffee and water for guests, printer access

## Who it is for

Freelancers, remote workers, digital nomads, travellers passing through Brașov, startups, small and large teams, and anyone who needs a meeting room, training room or event space for up to 40 people.

## Getting there

- By bus: Memorandului and Bisericii Române stops, lines 5, 14, 24, 28 and A1, about a 5-minute walk
- On foot: about 15 minutes from Piața Sfatului, the historic centre of Brașov
- By car: free public street parking along Strada Horia, first come, first served
- Entrance: through the black gate with the intercom on Strada Horia, along the path beside the building, to the wooden door with the "22A maccollab" sign

## Community and courses

- Community events for members and non-members, for example breakfasts, games afternoons and networking
- Every month, one person from a vulnerable background gets a dedicated desk free of charge
- Financial education and IT courses on Saturdays (10:00–11:00), one course each Saturday in turn, maximum 12 participants; 100 lei per person, reduced to 50 lei from the 15th to the end of each month
- Children's workshops co-organised with Atena Sport Brașov

## Booking

- Book a tour, a day pass, a desk or the conference room on the website, by phone at +40 731 624 845 or by email at office@maccollab.com
- Request a custom offer for offices and teams on the website

## În română

Maccollab este un spațiu de coworking și o clădire de birouri de închiriat în Brașov, pe Strada Horia 22A. Este singurul coworking din Brașov deschis 24/7, cu acces pe bază de card. Oferă day pass (15€ pe zi sau 50€ pe săptămână), birou dedicat (140€ pe lună), birou privat pentru 1–2 persoane (de la 220€ pe loc pe lună), birouri pentru echipe de 4–14 persoane (180€ pe loc pe lună) și o sală de conferințe pentru până la 40 de persoane (20€ pe oră sau 120€ pe zi). Toate prețurile includ TVA și utilitățile. La cerere, oferim și servicii de sediu social. Stațiile de autobuz Memorandului și Bisericii Române (liniile 5, 14, 24, 28, A1) sunt la 5 minute de mers pe jos, iar Piața Sfatului la 15 minute. Parcarea publică pe stradă este gratuită.
